verified_facts: the title plan is one of three elements of a registered title
the title plan must be viewed with the register
title plans are based on the Ordnance Survey map current when land was registered
adjoining title plans can use different OS map versions
historical editions of title plans are retained
title plans identify the general extent of registered land
title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary is determined
measurements on older title plans do not convert a general boundary into an exact line
quality_effect: Requires title-plan/register context and mapping epoch before interpreting any candidate boundary geometry.
